sourceConcurrency.description: How many independent sources to run in parallel.

boardConcurrency.description: How many boards/tenants/companies one adapter fetches in parallel.

pageConcurrency.description: How many paginated list pages a single tenant fetches in parallel (Workday).

detailConcurrency.description: How many per-job detail requests run in parallel per tenant (Workday).

actorConcurrency.description: How many Apify actors run in parallel.

hostConcurrency.description: How many requests may be in flight against ONE host (for Workday, one shared pod like wd5.myworkdayjobs.com) across every source. This is the ceiling the server actually enforces: many boards/tenants share a single host, so the per-source ceilings above cannot prevent a 429 on their own.
Optional per-source in-flight ceiling when the adapter creates its own host gate.

hostSpacingMs.description: Minimum delay between request starts against one physical host/pod.

maxDetailFetches.description: Maximum optional Workday full-description requests per tenant; cached descriptions do not consume this budget.

maxPostingsPerCompany.description: SmartRecruiters: ceiling on postings read per company across all pages. The adapter pages until totalFound is reached; this only stops a runaway loop.

boardConcurrency.description: How many boards/tenants this source fetches in parallel, overriding the global default. Safe to raise for Workday: every tenant is a different host and per-host politeness is enforced separately by the host gate, so with 200+ boards a low value is pure serialization.

maxSearchTerms.description: Workday: how many search phrases to derive from candidate.targetTitles per tenant (default 2). Each term multiplies that tenant's page cost, and Workday's search is fuzzy enough that a minimal cover of the title list suffices — measured, one phrase already recovered all but 3 on-target titles across 12 tenants. 0 disables searching (enumerate everything).

searchTexts.description: Workday: pin the search phrases for every tenant in this source, overriding the derivation from candidate.targetTitles. Keep each phrase to ~2 tokens: Workday's CXS search NARROWS as tokens are added (measured: 'data' 115 hits, 'data engineer' 51, a nine-word query 0).

maxAgeDays.description: atsSearch: hard ceiling on posting age in days (default 180; 0 disables). A zombie guard, not a freshness filter — cross-company search indexes keep requisitions nobody ever closed, and 89% of SmartRecruiters rows measured over a year old (oldest: 2014). Undated rows are kept.

dayRange.description: atsSearch/Workable: only return postings from the last N days (default 7). Workable ranks by relevance and accepts no sort parameter, so this is the only recency lever — and widening it displaces fresh jobs rather than merely adding old ones (measured: 7 days yields 137 jobs under a week old, 30 days only 76). Raise it only when back-filling.

searchText.description: Pin this tenant's single search phrase, overriding the phrases derived from candidate.targetTitles. An empty string means 'enumerate everything'.

searchTexts.description: Pin several search phrases for this tenant. Results are merged and de-duplicated before detail enrichment, so the per-tenant detail budget is spent once per job, not once per phrase.
